Deterministic Null

Why AI benchmarks need a placebo control group, and where giant models actually beat a simple lookup table.

[9 of 10 Bounded Ties · 3.59x Repeat Energy Cut]

1/3 Most AI benchmarks skip a zero-model control group that tests what simple lookup already solves.

2/3 On bounded math and database tasks, a frozen lookup table matched cloud AI on nine of ten tests.

3/3 On open coding tasks AI leaped ahead, while caching verified answers cut repeat energy three point six times.
